description:
Set a drop's status. Activating a push drop starts delivery to its recipients.

Params: store_id, drop_id, status ('draft'|'active'|'paused'|'ended'), session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, drop: Drop}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404, HTTP_409

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_set_drop_status
title: Set drop status
